title: Speaking — Exploring a new subject
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on exploring a new subject.

questions: What do you enjoy doing when you have an hour to yourself?
Are your hobbies different from when you were younger?
Do your relatives share any of your interests?
Is there a hobby you would like to learn from someone?
Where do you usually begin when you are curious about a subject?
Do you prefer a short introduction or a long explanation?

part2.topic: Describe a subject you began studying out of curiosity.
part2.closing: and explain how you would continue learning about it.

questions: How can libraries help people follow interests unrelated to school or work?
What makes some subjects appear harder to approach than they really are?
How has everyday life connected with exploring a new subject changed for people of different ages?
